1.mascotDialogue: Nothing flash here, mate — compare your neighbour, swap if you're bigger, repeat the whole sweep till nothing needs swapping anymore.

2.mascotDialogue: `n minus i minus 1` on line 3 shrinks the inner loop's range every pass — the last i elements are already sorted, no need to keep checking 'em again.

3.mascotDialogue: Watch the tallest bar creep one step right with every swap she loses — that's the 'bubbling' the algorithm's named after, made completely literal.

4.mascotDialogue: This one won't crash every time — she'll just, occasionally, read a load of garbage past the array. Exactly the sort of bug that slips by unnoticed, 'cause she doesn't always announce herself.
